name: openlmis-list-page
title: List Page
description: Complete users list screen on mock data: breadcrumbs and heading, a toolbar with search, a status filter, a View menu and Add User, a table with sorting, paging, empty and no-matches states, and row actions that open Edit User and Reset Password, with Add User going on to Set Password.
docs: Requires a `base-*` style in components.json (the `shadcn init` default). Legacy `new-york`/`radix-*` styles install Radix primitives, which reject the `render` prop this item uses.
